steps.content: [Message, size 14 subtitle also works]

<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: I've relayed the phenomena you described to our team of psychology experts.
<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: Based on their preliminary assessment, it remains inconclusive whether Phanuel has been subjected to external cognitive manipulation or systematic conditioning.

<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: What we can confirm is that her mental state and behavioral responses are noticeably underdeveloped for her age, showing strong dependency and little to no signs of autonomous decision-making.
<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: We've also analyzed all publicly available footage related to her, but given how highly scripted the samples are, it's been difficult to identify any nonverbal cues of diagnostic value.
<color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>: Any footage we could get our hands on has likely already been filtered and edited by her team.

<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: Currently, the experts don't recommend relying solely on observational interviews.
<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: We need to create an unfamiliar situation and draw out a reaction that's outside the script from her.
<color=#fb9259>Nightingale</color>: Only then will we be able to see who she truly is.
[Dark alley]

You use the trip to the convenience store as an excuse to contact Nightingale. When you step back out, Phanuel is still quietly waiting at the alley entrance. She's idly tapping her foot against the ground, with no apparent intention of running.

Her gaze drifts along the walls of the alley. The sea of flyers, the dust-covered scooters parked along the curb, the faded signs of the shops... All something she'd never get to see in her chauffeured van.
You open the small container you grabbed from the convenience store freezer and pass it to her.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What's this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The same thing those two girls you were staring at had.
She takes the spoon and cautiously scoops a bite. Then, she inspects it closely before carefully placing it in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Ahh, it's so cold!
She scrunches her nose. Still, she can't help but look down at the little container in her hands again, like she's just found some rare treasure.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What is this? I've never learned about this. Can you tell me?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Neapolitan ice cream. One of the few budget ice creams in the freezer that won't rob you blind. Pure artificial flavor.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: That's a pretty long name... but Phanuel's got it memorized!
Phanuel solemnly lifts the container above her head to read the ingredient list on the bottom.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: White sugar... non-dairy creamer... artificial flavoring...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh my... this one cup is several days' worth of calories for Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So... is the strawberry parfait just as terrifying as this? Eliza decided that's Phanuel's favorite food.
She scoops up another bite as she marvels at the dessert, holding it in her mouth for a long while before finally swallowing.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I wonder if my Cherubs actually believe that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... cute-looking desserts do suit your image.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Cute... People say that about Phanuel all the time. I don't really understand what being "cute" means, but as long as I smile the right way and strike the right pose, everyone seems happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's "cute" is different for everyone. Clumsy, gentle, the kind of person you just want to be close to...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So there are questions you can't answer too, Esteemed Reporter.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh... right, I still don't know your name. But everyone around me always includes some kind of title like that when they chat.
You say nothing to correct her assumption. She seems to be opening up now that you're on a familiar topic.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza says everything that makes Phanuel cute is calculated. The kind of face people like, personality, songs... there's a database for all of it. Everything I do has to match that data.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh, I get it now! The things Phanuel normally eats are just too un-cute! That's why strawberry parfait has to exist.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: One boiled egg in the morning, two cucumbers for lunch, and a small slice of whole wheat bread with an apple for dinner.

options: That can't be enough. Don't you get hungry?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But Phanuel can only maintain the perfect weight that way.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If the number on the scale goes over, that means Phanuel wouldn't be perfect in everyone's eyes. It would shatter so many people's illusions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What does weight have to do with illusions?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: They probably come in many, many varieties, just like "cute." I think so at least.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Some people want to become Phanuel, to shine on stage like me. So I always have to be the most dazzling version of that wish. Because when they look at Phanuel, they're looking at another possible version of "themselves."

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Some people fantasize about becoming Phanuel's partner. That's why I can't date, have any rumors, and I need to be warm and caring towards everyone. For them, Phanuel got them through some of their hardest days. Phanuel is a symbol of that time.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And for some others... when they don't know what to do with themselves, they discover that there's still one thing they can do—to love Phanuel! Something certain, something they can control and hold on to.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: The point is... as long as Phanuel stays perfect, they can keep believing that there's still something beautiful in this world.
It's the most you've ever heard her say in one breath. Maybe the ice cream actually managed to coax some rare honesty out of Phanuel—is what you think until she swallows a spoonful and says:

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: That's what Eliza says, at least.
She remains as calm as ever, her trust in and reliance on Eliza unshaken.
We need to create an unfamiliar situation and draw out a reaction that's outside the script from her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phanuel, if Eliza is behind the Hollow Syndrome, that'd mean she used you to hurt your fans. Would you still go back to her, keep working with her, and do everything she says then?
A long silence settles over the alley. Phanuel stares blankly at the ground.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know... There's so, so much I don't know...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Something must have happened to me before, something terrible. When I came to, I couldn't remember anything. I was all alone in the world.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I didn't know who I was, what I was good at, what I liked, how to make sense of the world, or what I could do.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But Eliza gave me all of that... including the name Phanuel, including the concert, a goal that means everything to both of us.
The Hollow Syndrome is still too foreign a concept for her, and so is a future without Eliza. She tilts her head, visibly at a loss.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: This is a tough one, Esteemed Reporter. Can I have some time to think about it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright, how about you give me your answer before the concert?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Okay, it's a promise!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And before you do, there's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Huh, that person looks really familiar. Isn't she... that idol who's been blowing up lately—
Phanuel's cover is blown.

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Phanuel! It's Phanuel!!
A figure in a grey trench coat races through the busy streets of Eastside, pulling the city's biggest star along by the hand.
The screams draw attention. An excited crowd closes in, phones raised.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ready to join this reporter's exclusive class? We're about to scape to a world beyond the spotlight!
The blaring horns below fade into the distance as you lead her up the overpass, passersby watching as you go.
[Small CG: Eloping]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lesson one: In this situation, a normal person would ask, "So, where are we going?"

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Wh-where are we going—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Honestly, I have no clue either. You feeling hot?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Huh? That's so sudden... What am I supposed to say?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lesson two: don't think, don't recall. Just tell me how you feel.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Emm... Yes?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why? What makes you feel that way?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sweating! My back feels all sticky, and my face is burning...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know what that is.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: The sun... It's so bright! I can't even open my eyes without my sunglasses!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You don't like the sun?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Maybe I'm just... not used to it? I rarely get to see the sun. Or the sky.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Every time I look up, all I see is a black umbrella over my head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Because I'd get a tan! Eliza always said female celebrities are not allowed to get tanned.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Anything else?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes! Reporters might photograph me. Eliza doesn't want me to be seen too often. She says I need to stay mysterious, otherwise people will lose interest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, which do you prefer? The umbrella, or the sky?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...I prefer now!
She isn't wearing the wings from her stage costume, yet right now, she's closer to the sky than she ever was.
You run and run, all the way to the end of the road, all the way past the city sprawl, and through the thick, humid midsummer haze.
And finally, at the mouth of an alley beneath an overpass, she lets go of your hand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What's wrong? Can't keep up?
You turn around. Her smile is brilliant under the sunlight, her golden hair radiant, reflecting the sun's rays. In this moment, Phanuel is more alive than any poster of her could ever capture.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then... let's stop here...

A wave of dizziness suddenly washes over you. Your fingertips go numb. Your eyes won't leave Phanuel's face. Something seems to be gently scratching at your chest, but the feeling isn't unpleasant. If anything, it's almost... comfortable.
The corners of your mouth curl up on their own, and your eyelids grow heavier and heavier...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Phanuel... Phanuel...
[Collapse]
